en.name: Nokhatha
en.hero_title: Be the captain of your home.
en.hero_lead: Reminders for the home and the car, and an eye on the subscriptions, with every date set to the Gulf's year from Suhail to Al-Kulaibain, and everything kept on your own device.
en.year_title: The Gulf's year, season by season
en.year_lead: People of the Gulf have long divided the year into seasons that tell the heat, the cold, the rain and the winds, and Nokhatha builds its dates on them: the ACs before Al-Kinna, the roof before Al-Wasm, the car before the summer.
en.year_note: Season names and start dates follow the traditional calendar used in Kuwait and across the Gulf, which starts the year with the rising of Suhail on 24 August. Start dates can differ by a day or two from one area to another.
en.features_lead: Every task tells you when and why in plain words, and you can mark it done with one tap, snooze it or change how often it comes.
en.home_body: AC filters every month and every two weeks through the heat and the Bawarih, AC servicing before the summer, the water tank, filter and heater, the roof, the kitchen hood, pest control, smoke alarms and the extinguisher, with a list for every house, chalet or farm, and two weeks before Ramadan a checklist to ready the house.
en.car_body: Oil and filters by kilometres or time, whichever comes first, an odometer estimated from your readings, tyres, battery and car AC before the summer, and when the registration comes due, the renewal path in the right order for your country with its official links, and one tap at the end sets the registration, insurance and inspection dates.
en.subs_body: See what you pay each month and each year, and before every renewal you are asked whether you still use it, so you cancel what you do not need before the money leaves, and a free trial never turns paid without you knowing.
en.docs_body: ID, passport, licence, residency and health cover for you, the family and the household staff, each with its own lead: residency reminds you two months ahead and the passport six, "needs first" reminds you of the health cover before the residency, and we keep the name and the date only, never the numbers.
en.features_more: And more: dust, rain and heat alerts for your area with the temperature, where dust is judged against what is usual for your place rather than a fixed number; warranties with a receipt photo; your technicians with call and WhatsApp next to their tasks; a checklist before the summer trip; the year's spending; the Hijri date with a countdown to Ramadan and both Eids; any task sent to whoever is doing it as a ready message; and anything else you want to track, like a boat, a generator, a pool or a camp.
en.privacy_title: Your data never leaves your device.
en.p1_body: There is no account, because the tasks, subscriptions and receipt photos live on your device and the dates are worked out there, so nothing reaches us; there is no analytics and no advertising watching what you do, and the app works offline after its first open.
en.p2_body: The backup is encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a key derived from your passphrase, so nobody but you can open it, and you can send it to the family or your other device, where it opens with the same passphrase.
en.p3_body: The app is closed on itself: its content security policy stops it from talking to any site except the weather service when you turn it on yourself, and even then it sends only an approximate location.
en.q1: With no account, where is my data kept?
en.a1: Inside your device, in the browser or the app, and it never goes anywhere else, so we have no need to know who you are.
en.q2: With no server, how does it track my dates and remind me?
en.a2: Your device works out the dates from the last time you logged each task and from the Gulf's seasons, so you see what is due as soon as you open it, and the reminders come from the device itself.
en.a3: No analytics and no advertising watching what you do, so we do not know who uses the app or what they record in it.
en.q4: What if I change my phone or clear the browser data?
en.a4: Your data is gone, because nobody holds a copy, so keep an encrypted backup from Settings and restore it on the new device.
en.q5: How do the weather alerts know my area?
en.a5: You pick your area from a list or let the app read your location, and we round it to about 10 km before it reaches the weather service.
en.platforms_lead: The same engine and the same dates on every device, and the same backup file opens in every version.
en.web_body: Works on any device, and you can pin it to your home screen.
en.ios_body: With device reminders, the weather and the encrypted backup.
en.android_body: With device reminders and a home screen widget.
en.meaning: The nokhatha is the captain of a pearling dhow, responsible for everything aboard, and this app makes you the captain of your home.
